description: assignNodeIndex(lastNodeIndex, lastNodeCount): a card joins the deck's last node while it has fewer than 10 cards, else the next node. Assignments never change afterwards (Story 3 #2).

cases.name: last node has 9 cards: still room
last node is full (10): start the next node
a node over-full (e.g. after import races) still moves on

sequences.name: 25 cards created in an empty deck fill nodes 0,0..,1..,2
deleting cards never reassigns: next card goes after the highest node (count of that node is what is live)
